title: I Built A Tool That Tracks Insider Trading
author: Nice_Emu_7249
selftext:
**5 years ago** when i came across **Deep F\*cking Value** and **Insider Trading** and ive been using it as part of my analysis every since.

(and its been working pretty well im up **45%** in the past year on my TFSA)

But openinsider always just felt laggy, missed a lot of filters and you always had to keep checking it since there wasnt an alert option. And other options like finviz and quiver quant lacked data or filters.

So earlier this year i decided to build [**kestrelterminal**](http://kestrelterminal.com/) as a side project for personal use to do exactly what openinsider couldnt.

Its free to use, but you do need a paid plan for the custom **alerts/strategies tab** (same ones I used to grow my tfsa).

But if any of yall are interested just lmk and ill give you **free access.**

It would mean a lot if you checked it out, and let me know if theres any changes I can make or improvements youd might like.

replies.author: RNAlgotrading
replies.body:
When corporate executives, directors, and large shareholders (people the SEC calls "insiders") buy or sell shares of their own company, they're legally required to report it by filing a Form 4 with the SEC, usually within two business days. These filings are public record, available for free on the SEC's EDGAR database. It shows the confidence, mainly when insiders Buy. They are legal insiders.  
Though it is a lagging indication like you feel, It's a good sign for short term / long term buyers.
